title: SmoothMC+
description: SmoothMC is a modpac aiming to making the game feel much more smooth.
body:
**SmoothMC**

SmoothMC is a lightweight modpack designed to make Minecraft feel smoother, faster, and more responsive.


✨ Key features:

Performance optimizations to reduce lag and stutter
Quality-of-life tweaks that improve the overall experience
